notes: Dreams are sturdier: consolidation can no longer choke when many similar memories chain into one giant cluster; oversized groups are now merged in safe chunks, so no more lost nights with a warning banner.

Soul curation arrives: when your kit's always-loaded memory tier outgrows its budget, it proposes a small, reversible cleanup batch as a single card you approve with one tap. Nothing moves without you, and identity memories are never touched.
Resume on the wake card now always points at the genuine last session, everywhere.

Sharper waking on coding surfaces: one patient message while a new kit finishes forming (instead of repeated waiting notes), clearer answers when a question could mean the open project or stored knowledge, and read-only keys say so upfront instead of failing quietly.
Housekeeping: client error messages are no longer stored as chat history, and the app's own release checks got stricter about API routes their tools depend on.
